S.FORM: squliq na ptqsinuw Tayal hya' ga ptqsinuw na squliq kruma' ka maha Tayal hya' ga yaqu tmqsinuw qu sqyanux naha' qani hya' ga, yalaw gi pncisal krayryax qu mmlikuy na Tayal ga, mutu giway zyuwaw na tmqsinuw nanak qu spkayal naha', ru yaqu zyuwaw 'nwahan naha' tmqsinuw qnanak qu spnqzyu' naha', qu zyuwaw yan nqani hya' ga mzyay' nqu laylaqi' mqwas biru' ka, ana ya'qu musa' mqwas biru' ru mqbaq miru' balay qu spzyang naha' s'usa' Gaku' ga, mwah ngasal lga giway nanak yaqu ima' qu spzyang balay haylaw mayqzinah, ima' qu spzayng balay baq mqwas, ru ima' qu lawkah balay mkzyap nanak spnqzyu' naha'. ungat ana qutux qu mwah pnqzyu' na maha maha nanu' kin blaq balay mqbaq biru'. nanu' ka mmlikuy na Tayal uzi ga, aw' yaqu mqumah qu spzyang naha' sqyanux ga, ungat ana qutux qu knayal na kinblaq psyaqan na mqumah hya', min'uqu' yaqu musa' tmqsinuw squ pinkzyapan naha' sa squliq qu spnqzyu' naha', nanu' misa yan nasa gi musa' tmqsinuw squ zyuwaw na mkzyap hya ga yasa qu mutuw skrahu' rqyas na mmlikuy ru.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]quliq na ptq[s|ɕ]inuw tajal ħjaʔ ɣa ptq[s|ɕ]inuw na [s|ɕ]quliq krumaʔ ka maħa tajal ħjaʔ ɣa jaqu tmq[s|ɕ]inuw qu [s|ɕ]qjanux naħaʔ qani ħjaʔ ɣa jalaw ɣi pn[ʦ|ʨ]i[s|ɕ]al krajrjax qu mmlikuj na tajal ɣa mutu ɣiwaj zjuwaw na tmq[s|ɕ]inuw nanak qu [s|ɕ]pkajal naħaʔ ru jaqu zjuwaw ʔnwaħan naħaʔ tmq[s|ɕ]inuw qnanak qu [s|ɕ]pnqzjuʔ naħaʔ qu zjuwaw jan nqani ħjaʔ ɣa mzjajʔ nqu lajlaqiʔ mqwa[s|ɕ] βiruʔ ka ana jaʔqu mu[s|ɕ]aʔ mqwa[s|ɕ] βiruʔ ru mqβaq miruʔ βalaj qu [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ naħaʔ [s|ɕ]ʔu[s|ɕ]aʔ ɣakuʔ ɣa mwaħ ŋa[s|ɕ]al lɣa ɣiwaj nanak jaqu imaʔ qu [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ βalaj ħajlaw majqzinaħ imaʔ qu [s|ɕ]pzajŋ βalaj βaq mqwa[s|ɕ] ru imaʔ qu lawkaħ βalaj mkzjap nanak [s|ɕ]pnqzjuʔ naħaʔ uŋat ana qutux qu mwaħ pnqzjuʔ na maħa maħa nanuʔ kin βlaq βalaj mqβaq βiruʔ nanuʔ ka mmlikuj na tajal uzi ɣa awʔ jaqu mqumaħ qu [s|ɕ]pzjaŋ naħaʔ [s|ɕ]qjanux ɣa uŋat ana qutux qu knajal na kinβlaq p[s|ɕ]jaqan na mqumaħ ħjaʔ minʔuquʔ jaqu mu[s|ɕ]aʔ tmq[s|ɕ]inuw [s|ɕ]qu pinkzjapan naħaʔ [s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]quliq qu [s|ɕ]pnqzjuʔ naħaʔ nanuʔ mi[s|ɕ]a jan na[s|ɕ]a ɣi mu[s|ɕ]aʔ tmq[s|ɕ]inuw [s|ɕ]qu zjuwaw na mkzjap ħja ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu mutuw [s|ɕ]kraħuʔ rqja[s|ɕ] na mmlikuj ru
